title: Solar System Explorer — explainer overview
notes: Warm gift framing + navigation overview. Synced 1:1 with slides in tools/make_demo_videos.sh.

lines.text: This is Solar System Explorer — another world on Star Learner, made for a six-year-old who wants to fly among the planets.
At the start you choose: Spaceship to fly yourself, or Solar System for a quiet narrated tour of the planets around the Sun.
In the spaceship, swipe across the worlds. Tap one to plot a course. The Sun is fair game too — we fly close, but we never land on a star.
A top-down map draws the path. Worlds are moving, so the ship aims ahead — and steers clear of anything in the way.
Then you fly it — engines burn and brake, planets stay little icons until you get close, and diving through the asteroid belt is a rush of tumbling rocks.
Park in orbit beside the world, learn more with a short video, or chart a new course. Exploration is the loop. Wonder is the reward.
